Pinned golang:1.24-bookworm installs sqlite3, tmux, asciinema; builds catalogctl and seed; RUN seed at image build. catalogctl is the operator binary; seed is Docker-only and excluded from reachable runtime LOC.
Primary operator entrypoint delegates to cli.Main.

Operator surface: commit/decode/apply/recover/checkpoint/inspect/empty-check plus --input/--cdc/--reset-output. Dispatches into engine.*; unknown command prints policy.Usage and exits 2. Starter still appends WAL BEGIN before argv parse.

Commit/Decode/Apply/Recover/Checkpoint/Inspect/EmptyCheck are live. Decode/Apply/Recover/Checkpoint invoke walvalidate and cdcevent/fence helpers (often via _=). Apply reads CDC JSONL and calls replica.Apply. Import closure therefore includes walvalidate, fence, and cdcevent.

WAL structural analyzer: LSN gaps/duplicates, BEGIN/COMMIT/ABORT pairing, orphan mutations, redo window past checkpoint, epoch agreement. Summarize/DescribeOpen/RedoWindow/OpenTxnIDs/EpochAgreement are invoked from engine/health. ContiguousLSNs/CommittedMutationLSNs/PairingOK have no catalogctl callers.

Replica LSN/epoch fencing: Classify skip/apply/reject-batch, BatchEpochOK, FilterApplicable, FirstRejectReason, SlotMatchesHealth, ConfirmedNotPastDurable. Invoked from engine.Apply, replica.Apply, and health.Build. Results currently discarded; apply still consumes every record. ScanLSNs/MonotonicLSNs/AdvanceConfirmed/RejectWholeBatch/CountSkips unused.
Typed CDC events with table/op/image validation, SoftParse, GroupByTxn, FromModel. Wired from engine.Decode/Apply. ParseAll/SortByLSN/ToMaps unused; FKRank duplicates schema.FKRank.

SQLite heap (row_version/txn_reg) plus replica.sqlite FK schema, WAL jsonl append/load, slot/indexes/checkpoint files, batched replica upsert/delete. Embedded engine DDL. Several methods (ReplaceWAL, InsertTenantMeta, InsertSKUMeta, RegisterCommitted, ReplicaUpsert) are seed-only, not catalogctl-called.

Commit assigns txn/lsn, writes BEGIN/mutations, runs constraints.Check, then COMMIT+heap.Install+indexes.Rebuild or ABORT+reject. LoadMutations parses JSONL ops. Coupled to snapshot, WAL, heap, indexes.

Merge/Evaluate implement snapshot+writeset PK/unique/FK/frozen/qty/hold-aggregate checks. CommittedConsistent is used by health.Build. Evaluate itself has no catalogctl caller; commit uses the thinner constraints.Check instead (starter overlay, not a toy module).
SnapshotVisible encodes xmin/xmax/writer/committed rules. Checkpoint uses it; snapshot.Visible still returns LatestXmaxNull including uncommitted rows.
Starter Decode scans heap sku versions with row-numbers as LSN rather than WAL. Reached from engine.Decode; Write emits cdc.jsonl. Reduced predicate on a real decode/write path.

Apply loads slot, calls fence helpers, reverse-FK orders via applyorder, builds applyexec ops, invokes ApplyReplicaBatch (error discarded), advances confirmed_lsn to max LSN, writes apply-report. Live apply state machine with starter fencing/order defects.
Recover restores checkpoint heap, applies post-checkpoint WAL mutations including uncommitted, bumps replica epoch, rebuilds indexes. Reached from engine.Recover and inspect.Inspect.

Build aggregates epoch/durable/checkpoint/replica/index/visibility/constraints/replica/recovery into health.json. Invokes walvalidate.Summarize and fence slot/LSN checks. Write is on every successful operator command plus inspect.

replicaConsistent compares replica rows to visible heap payloads; recoveryConsistent looks for uncommitted versions after checkpoint; noUncommittedVisible is the visibility_ok half. Distinct from fence/walvalidate.
Rebuild writes sku_code/offer_code maps from every version. Match compares against Expected, which always returns empty maps. Reachable starter index health, not a constant-output catalog.
Install mutates xmin/xmax versions after COMMIT. Current/xminVisible/xmaxHides duplicate visibility predicates. InstallRecord/AlignPK unused.
Runtime replica DDL (tenant/sku/offer/hold + FKs) loaded by store.OpenReplica. 27 NBC counted as runtime config.
Loaded by config.Load: isolation=snapshot, replica_epoch=3, cdc_source=wal. 1 NBC counted.
paths.SQLEngine points here but catalogctl never reads the file; engine DDL is embedded in store. Excluded from reachable runtime/config LOC (22 NBC).
14402-line INSERT dump (~3 MB). Stateful warehouse evidence only; excluded from runtime/config LOC.
Docker RUN /app/catalog/bin/seed only. Not in catalogctl import closure. 399 NBC excluded. Seeds 40 tenants / 20 SKUs / 8 offers plus WAL/replica/hold variation.
Shift notes assert epoch 3, open WAL txn s-crash-pending, CDC-from-heap disagreement, frozen tenants, replica only through sku batch. Current-state claims have solver-visible evidence.
Bounce log records trailing open WAL, heap pending sku, decode/apply vs confirmed_lsn disagreement, inspect touching replica epoch. Matches oncall notes.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Switching snapshot.Visible to SnapshotVisible without rebuilding indexes from committed-visible rows still leaves aborted versions in sku_code/offer_code maps.
Decoding committed WAL without using fence.Classify/FilterApplicable still applies every CDC row in reverse FK order and can rewind or jump confirmed_lsn.
Parent-first applyorder without epoch match still installs a foreign-epoch batch into replica.sqlite.
Calling overlay.Evaluate on commit while inspect still runs recover continues to bump epoch and install uncommitted redo on a read path.
Stopping CLI WAL BEGIN on unknown flags without requiring --input for commit still leaves other starter mutations.
Making health.index_ok true by emptying indexes.json matches the current Expected() shell and hides a wrong rebuild.
Advancing replica confirmed_lsn to max LSN while CDC LSNs are heap row numbers still desynchronizes apply from WAL.
Aborting constraints without installing heap but still rebuilding indexes, or the reverse, splits commit durability.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing core (store heap/replica/WAL, txn commit, overlay/visibility predicates, replica apply+order, health consistency, engine CLI verbs) would collapse commit, decode, apply, recover, and inspect. Removing the ~474 NBC of never-called helpers, unread schema.sql, cmd/seed, and seed.sql would not change current catalogctl starter outcomes. Discarding walvalidate/fence/cdcevent result values today means deleting those packages would also leave starter operator outputs unchanged, but the functions do run on operator paths and are domain logic the apply/decode/health contract needs, not empty shells.
